Line drawing in blue on white, no scale bar, no dimensions.

title: U.S. Pavilion - 14th Venice Biennale, floor plan (officeUS layout, final) [BIENNALE-14-03]
contents: Line floor plan of the whole pavilion with walls: rotunda with four niches and doors, service rooms (WC) behind the rotunda, four octagonal-cornered galleries, portico with four columns, U-shaped courtyard with tree canopy outline and steps; officeUS desks, tables and seats. Transparent PNG, no scale bar, no dimensions.
